annotations.title: Describe a DCAST API operation exactly

description: The exact contract of one Partner API operation, taken from the API's own OpenAPI document: path parameters, query parameters, the JSON body schema (types, required fields, allowed values, defaults, limits), an example, the response shape and a ready callWith template naming the calling tool for its method (dcast_read_operation, dcast_call_operation or dcast_delete_operation). Always call this before calling an operation you have not described in this conversation, and build REST integration code from it. Nothing here is generated by a model.

operationId.description: operationId from dcast_find_operation, for example post_me_webhooks (the typed-tool name or "POST /me/webhooks" also work)
